1.web: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
1.asv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

2.web: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
2.asv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh it away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he cleanseth it, that it may bear more fruit.

3.web: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
3.asv: Already ye are clean because of the word which I have spoken unto you.

4.web: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
4.asv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.

5.web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
5.asv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.

6.web: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
6.asv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

7.web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
7.asv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

8.web: “In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
8.asv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and so shall ye be my disciples.

9.web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
9.asv: Even as the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in my love.

10.web: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in his love.
10.asv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

11.web: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
11.asv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.

12.web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
12.asv: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as I have loved you.

13.web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
13.asv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

14.web: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
14.asv: Ye are my friends, if ye do the things which I command you.

15.web: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
15.asv: No longer do I call you servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I heard from my Father I have made known unto you.

16.web: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
16.asv: Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

17.web: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
17.asv: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.

18.web: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
18.asv: If the world hateth you, ye know that it hath hated me before it hated you.

19.web: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
19.asv: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

20.web: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will keep yours also.
20.asv: Remember the word that I said unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

21.web: But all these things will they do to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
21.asv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

22.web: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
22.asv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no excuse for their sin.

23.web: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
23.asv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

24.web: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.
24.asv: If I had not done among them the works which none other did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

25.web: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
25.asv: But this cometh to pass, that the word may be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

26.web: “When the Counselorhas come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
26.asv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall bear witness of me:

27.web: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
27.asv: and ye also bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
